description: The file defines a Java class EventWaitHelper used in testing scenarios to wait for device events with timeout handling.

classes.name: EventWaitHelper
classes.description: A helper class for test synchronization, allowing waiting for device events with timeout and reset capabilities.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for the event with a specified timeout in milliseconds. Returns true if event received, false if timed out.

methods.name: notifyWaiters
methods.description: Notifies waiting threads that the event has occurred by counting down the latch.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the latch for reuse in subsequent waits.
